extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data issues affecting the average body mass by sex. One exact duplicate row was removed. The label 'FEMALE' was normalized to 'female'. The column 'body_mass_g' was converted from text to numeric, correctly parsing values like '4,925'. Three extreme outliers in body mass (e.g., 3,700,000 g) were excluded as they were far outside the valid 2500-6500 g range. One row with an invalid negative flipper length was also excluded for data integrity. The average body mass is 3792.86 g for female penguins and 4492.00 g for male penguins.
